four_great_kings.description: Said to rule the four quarters/cardinal points (East, West, North, South), governing all 72 spirits; not to be called forth except upon Great Occasions, but to be invocated and commanded to send the spirit under their power.
four_great_kings.alternate_naming: A footnote states these four Great Kings are usually called Oriens (or Uriens), Paymon (or Paymonia), Ariton (or Egyn), and Amaymon (or Amaimon); by the Rabbins they are frequently entitled Samael, Azazel, Azäel, and Mahazael.

demons_explicitly_under_a_great_king.relation: First and choicest under the Power of AMAYMON; governs 72 Legions among the Legions of AMAYMON
Under AMAYMON, King of the East
Can teach the consecration of things belonging to the Dominion of AMAYMON his King

chief_spirits.description: Of the 72, these four are named as Chief. The text says Solomon bound them because of their pride, sealed them in the Vessel of Brass, and cast them into a deep lake or hole in Babylon; when the Babylonians broke the vessel open, the Chief Spirits flew out first with their legions following.
